memory: I recorded 5000 pushes: 16 false (0.32%) and 29 slips (0.58%). false≤0.5% is presently supported; slips≤0.6% is not. Normal-approx says ~5.54×10^5 total pushes are required to push the 95% upper bound to 0.006. Standing plan: staged interim batches; next is a randomized 50,000-push test with Δ1=10, deadband = median_w ±3·MAD_w, per-push median-latency drift uniform(−2,+2) ms. Decision rule will be CI-driven.
openQuestion: In a randomized 50,000-push interim (Δ1=10, same deadband, ±2 ms drift), how many slips occur and does the 95% upper bound for slip rate fall ≤0.006?
